_doc: League Bosses (M10): original themed AI teams built from the real player pool. focus = position groups drafted stronger (QB RB WR TE OL DL LB DB ST), style = base offense (coach.json styles), defStyle = signature defensive scheme (coach.json defStyles), baseFront = 4-3 / 3-4. final = only met in the championship.

bosses.name: Air Raid Aces
bosses.scheme: Four wide, chuck it deep, every down.

bosses.name: Ground Pounders
bosses.scheme: Two tight ends, a fullback and a 300-pound wall.

bosses.name: Blitz Brigade
bosses.scheme: Six and seven rushers. Get the ball out or get hit.

bosses.name: No Fly Zone
bosses.scheme: Press-man corners and a ball-hawk safety.

bosses.name: Iron Curtain
bosses.scheme: Win both lines of scrimmage, then grind.

bosses.name: Speed Demons
bosses.scheme: Track stars everywhere: jet sweeps and go routes.

bosses.name: Special Forces
bosses.scheme: Field position, a cannon-legged kicker, return men.

bosses.name: Gunslingers
bosses.scheme: A gunslinger QB and seam-stretching tight ends.

bosses.name: Monsters of the Middle
bosses.scheme: Downhill linebackers who live in the backfield.

bosses.name: Spread Kings
bosses.scheme: Empty sets, quick game, RPOs on every snap.

bosses.name: The Fortress
bosses.scheme: Bend-don't-break zones that never give up the big one.

bosses.name: The Dynasty
bosses.scheme: Champions at every position. The final boss.
